Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.core

Class TelemetrySession

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.core.TelemetrySession
All Implemented Interfaces:
TelemetryObserver
public class TelemetrySession extends Object implements TelemetryObserver
One BlueJ session: its anonymous student ID, start and end times, the folder of the last project opened, and the event log. It is a concrete observer in the Observer pattern.
Author:
Haeley Parbhoo
